derivative_path: Coordinate-only VJP of the pointwise local reward on the matched support [4,14,15]; the element/charge matching branch is detached (sensing detached, typed_weight 0.0, charge_weight 0.0), so no gradient flows through element or charge logits. Model VJP applies only to the current call, not to all future stochastic generations. Routing is single and does not stop gradient on the coordinate path; state-dependent weights are not differentiated, so only conditional routing gradients are claimed, not exact derivatives of a full mixed potential. Hard category/chemical-graph identification is used only for gradient-free routing. Element, charge, and necessary bond information come from the existing generation head; formal charge is a separate channel and is not asserted to be partial charge, pKa, or interaction free energy.

falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, with the same parent program and numerical option A000, the interface15 local predictive-bridge residual does not decrease relative to the parent, or if the qualified tail (best_qualified_pic50 / hit_fraction) does not improve beyond the parent R15_V3_COMPATIBLE values (best_qualified_pic50 8.590141, hit_fraction 0.02). It is also falsified if the learning-end ancestor for the selected seeds does not place slots [4,14,15] near the interface15 pocket sites, i.e. the support is not actually occupied at the teacher time.
